title: Coordinate resampling noise
statement: Let $\rho\in[0,1]$ and let $x\in\{\pm1\}$. Define a random sign by retaining $x$ with probability $\rho$ and, with probability $1-\rho$, drawing a sign uniformly from $\{\pm1\}$; the resulting probability mass function is the coordinate resampling noise distribution at $x$.
